answer: Re-attestations are stored in bridge and mirror lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the hollow graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1771 impostors cost 1789 times the honest price and take 19 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
